buildNotes:
This build includes the following changes:
- Removed Liveblocks collaboration; Google Docs sync for SOPs and prof emails remains
- Cloudflare Workers: Hyperdrive Postgres, shell session hydration, billing config cache
- Vitest + Playwright test suite (134+ tests), ≥80% coverage gates, CI on every push
- Styled confirmation modal replaces native confirm for all deletes and disconnects
- School AI infer: server-side save, faster infer path, instant UI cache sync
- Pessimistic delete UX: items stay visible with loader until API succeeds
- Run `pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy` for collaboration table removal migration
